BiblicalUsage: Dibri is named only once, as the father of Shelomith, the Israelitish woman whose son blasphemed the Name and was stoned. His name survives in the record of a judgment the law made plain.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a hard judgment is worth recording truly. Dibri's son is named, his mother is named, and the law is carried out, because God's name is not a thing to be spoken lightly.
